global_prompt: A photorealistic cinematic fantasy-action sequence filmed entirely from a first-person perspective in a bustling modern city during daylight. The camera represents the eyes of a pedestrian walking along a crowded sidewalk, with natural handheld head movements and realistic human eye-level framing. Tall buildings, busy roads, pedestrians, storefronts, and moving traffic create a lively urban environment.
local_prompts: The camera turns toward a building as a masked robber bursts outside carrying a duffel bag full of stolen money.
The robber runs toward a parked black car, opens the driver's door, and climbs inside with the stolen money.
The robber drives away from the curb as the first-person camera follows it.
A giant dragon flies overhead between city skyscrapers as the first-person camera looks upward.
The dragon lands directly on the getaway car, completely flattening it beneath its massive body.
The dragon stands over the crushed car, spreads its wings, and opens its glowing jaws as it breathe fire.
